messages.subject: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer a price of €38.50 per unit. As a practical shop, we like to keep things simple and direct. You can count on our usual hands-on quality and clear communication for this work. 

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.50 EUR per unit (offer:70240-0).
We read that Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).
We can work with your lead time of 28 days.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the news data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. As an alternative, since you offered to pay faster for a better price, let's do 14 days payment and I'll drop the price to 30.50 EUR: a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

We don't do cost breakdowns, but with your 4,200 pcs volume this is a solid deal. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I am the owner, so I approve the prices myself. With your 4,200 pcs volume and 14 days payment, I can drop the price to 29.50 EUR. Our current Angebot is a price of €29.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €29.50 per unit. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (3)
messages.body:
Hallo,

The volume change figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. 

We have already given you our best price at 29.50 EUR for the 4,200 pcs. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €29.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Let's close the deal at 29.50 EUR and get to work.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
